sources.evidence_extract: Retrieved from the manufacturer's own site umw-ic.com (title block: UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited, UMW branding, Jun.2025, 28 pages). LM2596S-ADJ is the ADJ-output TO-263 orderable. Abs max supply 45 V (LM2596, non-HV); operating supply 4.75-40 V; ON/OFF and Feedback pin abs max -0.3 to +25 V. ADJ feedback voltage 1.23 V typ, 1.193/1.267 V limits (1.180/1.280 over temp). Current limit 4.5 A typ, 3.6 A min. Oscillator 150 kHz (117-183). thetaJC 2 C/W; TO-263 thetaJA 50/30/20 C/W per notes 12-14 copper areas. Inverting Regulator section bootstraps the GND pin to the negative output and grounds the feedback pin; startup can draw current-limit-level input current (approx 4.5 A) for 2 ms or more and current-limited sources may not work correctly.
